integrity: Analytical proof with reproducible finite checker; finite tests do not certify infinite asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: The frequency cosets are constrained to equally spaced shifts; the objective is a Gram determinant, not the minimum Riesz eigenvalue or condition number. The asymptotic optimizer classification is eventual and gives no explicit universal threshold. Older restricted-Vandermonde-design literature may contain alternative formulations; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp arithmetic determinant gap for three-coset Fourier bases on separated integer intervals
